name: Khan Jahan Ali
role: Sufi administrator and regional builder in Bengal
contribution: He is associated with settlement expansion, mosque-building, and civic infrastructure in southern Bengal.
context: In the fifteenth-century Bengal Sultanate period, his activity in the Khalifatabad-Bagerhat zone reflected the linkage of frontier governance, religion, and urbanization.
impact: His architectural and regional legacy remains central to historical memory in southwestern Bengal.
highlight: A formative figure in the early urban and religious landscape of southern Bengal.
seoTitle: Khan Jahan Ali: Builder of Bagerhat’s Sultanate Landscape
seoDescription: Learn about Khan Jahan Ali’s association with settlement, mosque building, and regional administration in fifteenth-century southern Bengal and Bagerhat.
shortAnswer: Khan Jahan Ali was a Sufi administrator associated with settlement, mosque building, and the urban development of the Bagerhat-Khalifatabad region.
